name: pstack
description: if you want to go fast, go deep first. pstack helps you write less, but higher quality code. rigorous agent workflows you can parallelize with confidence.

skills.name: architect
skills.description: Sketch types, signatures, and module structure before code, then stay in the loop while implementation fills in.

skills.name: arena
skills.description: Spawn N parallel candidates at the same task, pick a base, graft the strongest parts of the losers into it.

skills.name: blast-radius
skills.description: Find what a change could break somewhere else before it ships, and prove the one fact it's safe because of.

skills.name: create-verification-skill
skills.description: Generate a project-local verification skill that drives your app the way a user does.

skills.name: figure-it-out
skills.description: Design an auditable playbook when no narrower one fits: large migrations or multi-part changes.

skills.name: how
skills.description: Code walkthroughs before changing something; placement / ownership / layering questions.

skills.name: interrogate
skills.description: Adversarial / multi-model review to stress-test code and find blind spots.

skills.name: maintain-verification-skill
skills.description: Periodic pass that keeps a project's verification skill and feature map honest.

skills.name: no-comments
skills.description: Spawn Comment Sicko, fix accepted findings, and offer encodings for claimed constraints.

skills.name: recall
skills.description: Reconstruct recent working context from chat history, live state, and shared record.

skills.name: reflect
skills.description: Spawn parallel review subagents over the transcript; route learnings into skill edits.

skills.name: show-me-your-work
skills.description: Keep a reviewable TSV decision trail for long-running or unattended work.

skills.name: swarm
skills.description: Fan out N parallel workers, drain them, and return one report.

skills.name: tdd
skills.description: Use when explicitly asked for TDD, a failing test, or a cheap local regression target.

skills.name: teach
skills.description: Explain a body of work plainly by weaving how and why into one clear explanation.

skills.name: why
skills.description: Design rationale, regressions, postmortems, or data-backed thresholds.

skills.name: automate-me
skills.description: Create/update/refresh a -mode skill from preferences or working style.

skills.name: bro
skills.description: Restate the last message in plain human language, with no jargon.

skills.name: make-bot-ui
skills.description: Build a custom UI that wakes a Grok Bot over a webhook.

skills.name: poteto-mode
skills.description: poteto's agent style: concise detailed responses, deliberate subagents, unslopped prose, simple code, verified work.

skills.name: setup-pstack
skills.description: Configure which models pstack uses per role and at what reasoning budget.

skills.name: principle-attack-the-premise
skills.description: When two or more fixes that share one premise have failed the same gate, attack the shared premise.

skills.name: principle-boundary-discipline
skills.description: Concentrate guards at system boundaries (CLI, config, network, external APIs).

skills.name: principle-build-the-lever
skills.description: For non-trivial work, build the tool that does it or proves it.

skills.name: principle-encode-lessons-in-structure
skills.description: Encode recurring corrections as lints, metadata, or structure — not repeated prose.

skills.name: principle-exhaust-the-design-space
skills.description: For novel UI/architecture with no precedent, build 2–3 competing prototypes and compare.

skills.name: principle-experience-first
skills.description: Choose user delight over implementation convenience; ship fewer polished features.

skills.name: principle-fix-root-causes
skills.description: Trace each symptom to its root cause; reproduce first; resist nil-check patches.

skills.name: principle-foundational-thinking
skills.description: Before writing logic: choose core types and data structures; sequence scaffold vs feature.

skills.name: principle-guard-the-context-window
skills.description: Route bulk to subagents; keep summaries in the main context.

skills.name: principle-laziness-protocol
skills.description: Bias toward deletion and the smallest change when tempted to add abstractions.

skills.name: principle-make-operations-idempotent
skills.description: Design commands and loops that converge to the same end state amid retries.

skills.name: principle-migrate-callers-then-delete-legacy-apis
skills.description: Migrate callers and delete the old API in the same wave.

skills.name: principle-minimize-reader-load
skills.description: Count layers between question and answer; reduce hidden state in the reader's head.

skills.name: principle-model-the-domain
skills.description: Encode the domain in a structure the code can share instead of repeating shape assumptions.

skills.name: principle-never-block-on-the-human
skills.description: On reversible work, proceed and present the result; let the human course-correct after.

skills.name: principle-outcome-oriented-execution
skills.description: Converge on the target architecture; don't preserve smooth intermediate states as goals.

skills.name: principle-prove-it-works
skills.description: Verify against the real artifact before declaring done.

skills.name: principle-redesign-from-first-principles
skills.description: Integrate new requirements as if they had been foundational from day one.

skills.name: principle-separate-before-serializing-shared-state
skills.description: Eliminate shared mutable state first; serialize structurally only if needed.

skills.name: principle-sequence-verifiable-units
skills.description: Break multi-step work into small units that can each be verified.

skills.name: principle-subtract-before-you-add
skills.description: Remove dead code and stubs first, then build on the cleaned surface.

skills.name: principle-test-behavior-not-implementation
skills.description: Call code the way users do; assert observed results against literal expectations.

skills.name: principle-type-system-discipline
skills.description: Make illegal states unrepresentable in types and signatures.

skills.name: technical-writing
skills.description: Layered technical-writing standard: Diátaxis, Google developer style, STE, Global English.

skills.name: typescript-best-practices
skills.description: TypeScript best practices when reading or editing any .ts or .tsx file.

skills.name: unslop
skills.description: Cut AI tells from any writing. Must always apply.
